resources.string: Larger bubble text during a dash

Choose delivery apps to monitor. Full rule support enables dash tracking. Debug builds can save screen and notification text for rule development; filters may miss customer details. Census sharing is off by default; developer toggles can send filtered skeletons and, for trusted installs, UNKNOWN screen text to the configured server. Release builds save no development captures and upload no census data. Local debug captures last until removed or uninstalled and are excluded from backup and transfer.

Export all history to a folder you choose.
deliveries.csv: one row per delivery
sessions.csv: one row per dash
summary.csv: totals and estimated IRS mileage deduction

Store names are included; customer and address hashes are excluded. DashBuddy writes the files through Android's folder provider; a cloud folder may upload them. Files survive uninstall; delete them from that folder. Existing files with these names are replaced.
Exported %1$d files to the chosen folder.
Export failed (%1$s). Check the folder and try again.

Save dashbuddy-log.txt in a folder you choose for diagnosis. It contains INFO+ milestones. Every line is checked for known sensitive text before writing; matches are replaced. Filters may miss details, so review before sharing. DashBuddy does not send the report to the developer. A cloud folder may upload it. The file survives uninstall; delete it from that folder. An existing dashbuddy-log.txt is replaced.
Log export failed (%1$s). Check the folder and try again.

Android Accessibility reads enabled delivery apps to recognize offers, pickups and deliveries on your phone. Automated actions stay off until allowed; DashBuddy asks when one becomes available and asks again if its rule layout changes. Taps stay inside the delivery app and must match the action\'s button label. The pay-details arrow has no label; only the app boundary is checked. Turning an action off stops automation; direct Accept and Decline presses still request taps. Built-in and downloaded rules grant nothing by themselves. Each decision is saved on this phone with its time, app version and privacy revision until app data is cleared or uninstalled. Backup and device transfer exclude these records, so a new phone asks again.
No actions available. Actions appear when loaded delivery-app rules provide them.
Press Accept in DashBuddy to request an Accept or Add to route tap inside %1$s. The button label is checked in %1$s. Your press works without an automation grant.
Press Decline in DashBuddy to request a Decline tap inside %1$s. The button label is checked in %1$s. Your press works without an automation grant.
With quick declines and this action allowed, DashBuddy taps the second Decline button in %1$s after you start a decline. It checks the label and stays inside %1$s.
DashBuddy taps the arrow on a completed %1$s delivery to read its pay breakdown for your records. The arrow has no label; only the app boundary is checked. Delivery, pay and settings are unchanged.
Recommend Accept; disabled shopping still gets Decline
Off: shopping offers score Decline. Nothing is tapped for you.
Confirm a decline you start; requires confirmation-tap consent
Drag to reorder. Rules at the top have more weight.

Screenshots are off by default. Saving requires this switch and a category below; categories start on. Images capture the whole display, including customer details and other apps, and are saved to Pictures/DashBuddy. DashBuddy does not upload them; gallery sync or sharing can. Images survive uninstall; delete them in the gallery. Turn this switch off to stop new captures. Dash history and debug text captures are separate.
Which dash the bubble shows while two platforms are online. Platform chips appear on cards and the chat header in every mode.
Follows whichever platform you last touched. Picking a platform in the bubble\'s switcher holds until that dash ends, then it goes back to following.
Your switcher pick sticks until you change it — including across that platform\'s next dash. While the pinned platform is offline the bubble falls back to following.
Test mode: one card stack folding every live dash, each card chipped with its platform. The switcher is hidden and chat stays on the followed dash.
Optional. If declined, DashBuddy stays usable and receives events only from supported delivery apps. Change this under Settings → Data & Privacy → Automation & Consent.

Allow Android Accessibility events from every app to notice delivery offers over other apps. Only enabled delivery apps\' window content is inspected or captured; other windows are identified by app name, with no content stored. Offer screenshots are off by default. If enabled under Settings → Data & Privacy, they save the whole display, including apps behind the offer, to Pictures/DashBuddy. DashBuddy does not upload these images; gallery sync or sharing can. Images survive uninstall; delete them in the gallery. Turn Screen events off in %1$s. This decision, time, app version and privacy revision stay on this phone and are excluded from backup and device transfer. Release stays usable when declined; debug disables the service.

Forgets this phone\'s census install id and secret and deletes the queued skeletons and captures and switches capture sharing off. The next upload enrols a new install id, which the census server must trust again. Your upload consent setting is left unchanged.

Sends the text of UNKNOWN screens to the census server while this install is trusted there. UNKNOWN screens get no rule redaction — only the marker backstops — so a capture can still contain customer details, and the server operator can read them.
